title: Professional Email Term Renewal: Seats of Deleted Mailboxes
content:
**Rule.** The renewed seats of a Professional Email term renewal — the seats it bills — turn on the idle seats of the current term. The idle seats are the mailbox deletions recorded on the subscription in the current term less the restores of those deletions, a deletion counting in the current term, and its restore with it, where the whole calendar months from the deletion date to today are no more than the whole calendar months from the term start date to today. Where a scheduled seat count is set, the renewed seats are the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count on the subscription, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, the seat count less the idle seats; where no scheduled seat count is set and the idle seats are above zero, they are the seat count less the idle seats; otherwise they are the seat count on the subscription, every licensed seat being billed.

**Cases (hypothetical subscription with a seat count of 23; term start 4 July, today 27 July, so 0 whole calendar months).**

| Deletions in the term | Restores of those deletions | Idle seats | Scheduled seat count | Renewed seats |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1 | 3 | none | 20 |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 18 | the lower of 18 and 23 is 18, never fewer than 20 in use: 20 |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 22 | 22 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | none | 23 |

A deletion on 30 June, 0 whole calendar months before 27 July, counts in the current term; a deletion on 20 June, 1 whole calendar month before it, does not.
